_provenance: DERIVED from avrae@cb75be2 (2026-08-06) Combat.get_summary and Combatant.get_summary. NOT AN EMBED -- the initiative tracker is a pinned plain message wrapping an ```md code block in message.content. A parser that only reads message.embeds never sees it at all.
_description: Format is f"{init:>2}: {name} {hp_str}{effects}" where hp_str is "<12/34 HP>" and effects render as a parenthetical "(AC 16, Prone)". The leading "# " marks ONLY the combatant whose turn it is; everyone else is indented two spaces.

message.content:
```md
Current initiative: 12 (round 3)
================================
# 18: Dorn <28/34 HP> (AC 16, Prone)
  12: Kethra <0/32 HP> (AC 14)
   7: Goblin Boss <5/21 HP> (Poisoned)
```
